snacs_adapt_notes.txt:
Useful general rules from purchased examples:
1) since with a past-time interval like 'It’s been a few years since ...' => role+function = Time/Time.
2) possessive 's on a person/organization can be Gestalt/Gestalt.
3) possessive pronoun before a noun often splits into role Possessor or OrgMember and function Possessor; choose OrgMember when the possessor is an organizational member/collective 'our business', choose Possessor for ordinary possessive.
4) each of you: 'of' = QuantityItem/Whole.
5) proud of NP: 'of' = Stimulus/Topic.
6) your before a noun in possessive use can be Agent/Gestalt when it denotes the actor-like owner of an action noun (e.g., your contributions).
7) throughout the year: Duration/Duration.
8) recommend X to someone: 'to' = Recipient/Goal.
9) save your money and go somewhere else: 'your' = Possessor/Possessor.
10) of in 'rewards of this program' can be Force/Force.
